scope: Observed deliveries in this repository; not model-brand ranking or a global capability certification.

zcode.strength: core implementation, concurrency debugging, meaningful regression
zcode.boundary: UI screenshot interpretation and unmeasured physical performance need independent checks

minimax.strength: asset engineering, deterministic processing, counterexample-driven tooling
minimax.boundary: visual approval and final handoff synchronization need strict evidence
next: SW022 one layer calibration then three-layer batch

antigravity.strength: coordination, deterministic checks, evidence collection and correction
antigravity.boundary: fact accuracy and actual UI execution are not reliable enough for sole release decision
next: connect discoverable and real UI tests with ZCode dependency support
raw-evidence review and second non-author check before claiming full visual/release validation

trae-design.strength: editable design package and repeatable references
trae-design.boundary: product numbers and dp/px/runtime ownership require implementation cross-check
next: reuse accepted SW021; no new design task this stage

qualification: No device measurement does not imply lack of ability. Prior approval pointers and source code are unchanged.
